name: product-documentation
description: Two skills sharing one Definition of Good (references/definition-of-good.md, owned entirely by this plugin, never sourced from the calling repo): review (/product-documentation:review) — a read-only documentation audit fanned out across three parallel angles (consistency, quality, completeness) and merged before relay; authoring (not user-invocable) — auto-loads before doc writes to apply the same rubric and run a pre-edit clause inventory on structural changes.
